issues.description: SQL Injection in getSubscription() via raw string concatenation with userId
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: await db.query("SELECT * FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = $1", [userId])

issues.description: SQL Injection in searchSubscriptions() via unescaped filters and orderBy clause
issues.suggestion: Whitelist allowed order columns and parameterize filter clauses

issues.description: Remote Code Execution / Arbitrary Execution risk via eval(amountStr) in chargeCard()
issues.suggestion: Replace eval() with strict numeric parsing: Number(amountStr) or parseFloat(amountStr)

issues.description: Sensitive Data Exposure: Plaintext credit card numbers, CVVs, and passwords logged to stdout
issues.suggestion: Completely remove credit card, CVV, and raw password logging to prevent PCI-DSS violation

issues.description: Insecure Cryptography: MD5 used for password hashing
issues.suggestion: Use modern salted adaptive hashing algorithms such as bcrypt or Argon2

issues.description: Hardcoded payment secrets and administrative tokens in source repository
issues.suggestion: Move PAYMENT_API_SECRET and ADMIN_OVERRIDE_TOKEN to environment variables

issues.description: Broken Access Control in isAdmin(): Client can forge req.body.isAdmin to gain full admin privileges
issues.suggestion: Verify admin rights strictly server-side using cryptographically signed session tokens

issues.description: Insecure randomness: Math.random() used to generate authentication / subscription tokens
issues.suggestion: Use crypto.randomUUID() or crypto.randomBytes(32) for secure token generation

codeQuality.summary: CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT: Multiple high-severity vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, eval() execution, hardcoded keys, MD5 hashing, plaintext credential logging, and broken authentication.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical customer subscription status resolver lacks test verification
User billing onboarding and database insertion has zero unit or integration tests
Access control gate must be verified against unauthorized spoofing and header inspection
Financial payment processing must be unit tested with mock HTTP provider
Enforces plan quotas between free and premium accounts

testCoverage.summary: Zero test coverage for mission-critical subscription and billing subsystems.

suggestions.description: Refactor string query assembly into parameterized database client or repository layer
suggestions.before: const rows = await db.query("SELECT * FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = '" + userId + "'");
suggestions.after: const rows = await db.query("SELECT * FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerabilities and permits query plan caching in database driver

suggestions.description: Replace eval() with safe numeric coercion and validate payment payload
suggestions.after:
const amount = Number(amountStr);
if (Number.isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) throw new Error("Invalid payment amount");
suggestions.benefits: Completely eliminates Arbitrary Code Execution vulnerability

suggestions.description: Use crypto.randomUUID() for tokens and Argon2/bcrypt for password hashing
suggestions.after:
const token = `sub_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
const passwordHash = await hashPassword(req.body.password);
suggestions.benefits: Replaces cryptographically broken MD5 and predictable random tokens with secure primitives

refactorings.summary: Fundamental security and architectural overhaul required to eliminate critical vulnerabilities.

issues.description: Console logging raw SQL queries in production driver
issues.suggestion: Use a structured debug logger instead of console.log

codeQuality.summary: Minimal database shim; requires connection pooling and parameterization support.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Verify connection initialization and query dispatch

suggestions.description: Support parameterized queries by accepting values array: query(sql, params)
suggestions.after: async query(sql, params = []) { logger.debug('SQL query', { sql, params }); return []; }
suggestions.benefits: Enables safe parameterized query execution across all consumers

refactorings.summary: Extend shim to support parameterized queries.

recommendations.description: BLOCK MERGE: Remediate severe SQL Injection flaws across getSubscription, searchSubscriptions, and createSubscription using parameterized queries
Remove eval() from chargeCard() and replace with strict numeric validation to prevent Remote Code Execution
Cease logging plaintext credit card numbers, CVVs, and passwords immediately (PCI-DSS violation)
Extract PAYMENT_API_SECRET and ADMIN_OVERRIDE_TOKEN to environment variables
Fix broken access control in isAdmin(): do not trust unverified client req.body.isAdmin payload
Author unit and integration tests for billing, payment processing, and access control
